query: Which material can be used for to improve the ductility and toughness of the HfZrTi high-entropy alloy (HEAs), and why?

generation.hypothesis: The addition of 10 at.% Ni to the HfZrTi high-entropy alloy (HEAs) will improve its ductility and toughness by 30% and 25%, respectively, compared to the as-cast baseline, due to the introduction of ductile and tough elements that refine the grain structure and reduce the Peierls stress.
generation.predicted_outcome: 30% increase in ductility and 25% increase in toughness
generation.boundary: 10% increase in ductility and 15% increase in toughness
generation.uncertainty: The actual improvement in ductility and toughness may vary depending on the specific processing conditions and microstructure of the alloy.

falsification_experiment.design: tensile testing and Charpy impact testing
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: if the measured increase in ductility and toughness is less than 10% and 5%, respectively, then the hypothesis is falsified.
